title: Low cards across four suits
author_notes: Reviewed during EC-033 implementation; see docs/COACHING_REVIEW.md. Independent hand; ratings are authored judgments, not probabilities or guaranteed outcomes.

feedback.title: A credible zero plan
feedback.summary: Low cards in every suit give you ways to follow without winning. Dash is plausible, but zero is never assured.
points: Control: there are no Aces, Kings, or Queens in this hand.
Escape: low cards across all four suits reduce early forced wins.
Risk: a suit can become trump, and surviving low cards can become winners late.

feedback.title: Keep the decision open
feedback.summary: Entering preserves flexibility while trump is unknown. It does not commit this low hand to a four-trick bid.
points: The opening minimum applies to a normal bid, not to the choice to enter.
Do not invent four winners from low cards just because you entered.
Dash is also defensible here; the choice concerns a zero commitment before trump is known.
